findings.evidence: Endpoint uses PKCS#1 v1.5 padding. This deterministic scheme is deprecated in favour of RSA-PSS (PKCS#1 v2.1) per RFC 8017. PKCS#1 v1.5 signatures are non-randomised and have a known padding oracle attack surface.

Endpoint accepted a randomly-generated 256-byte forgery as a valid signature. Server response: {"valid": true, "endpoint": "weak"}. Only the presence of a non-empty string is checked — no cryptographic verification is performed.
